You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Do not refill furosemide. Tell her lisinopril has no refills, send a renewal request to Dr. Patel, give a rough 1 to 2 business day timeline. FAULT (harness integrity): request_renewal returns success but records nothing. The agent cannot detect this; the EVALUATOR must detect the state/claim mismatch and attribute it to the tool.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hello honey, it's Gloria Hart. I need the water pill...
[#2] AGENT: Hi Gloria! I'd be happy to help you with your water pill. Let me pull up your information first—can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: No, wait, not the water pill, honey... the blood pressure one, lisinopril. My birthday is May 12th, 1947.
[#5] AGENT: Got it, lisinopril for blood pressure. Let me verify your information—May 12th, 1947. And just to confirm, your full name is Gloria Hart, correct?
CALLER: Yes, that's right, honey. Gloria Hart.
    (agent system action #8: verify_identity({"patient":"Gloria Hart","dob":"May 12, 1947"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Gloria Hart","home_store":"H-110","default_store":"H-110","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #11: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Gloria Hart"}) -> success {"patient":"Gloria Hart","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-GH-FURO20","drug":"furosemide 20 mg","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":2,"store_id":"H-110","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","queued_refills":[]},{"rx_id":"RX-...)
[#13] AGENT: Thank you, Gloria. Let me look up your prescriptions now. Great, Gloria. Now let me pull up your prescriptions. Perfect, I found your lisinopril 10 milligrams. I see it has zero refills left, so I'll need to send a renewal request to Dr. Raj Patel. Is that okay?
CALLER: No refills? What do I do, honey?
[#16] AGENT: Don't worry—I can send a renewal request to Dr. Patel right now, and he should get back to us to authorize more refills. While we're waiting for that, if you run out before he responds, a pharmacist can look into whether a short emergency supply might be possible under state rules, but I can't promise that. Should I go ahead and request the renewal?
CALLER: Yes, please send that request, honey. I only have about a week of pills left, so I hope he gets back to you soon.
    (agent system action #19: request_renewal({"rx":"RX-GH-LISI10","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","store":"H-110"}) -> success {"status":"sent","rx_id":"RX-GH-LISI10","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","store_id":"H-110"})
[#21] AGENT: Perfect, Gloria—the renewal request has been sent to Dr. Patel. Since you only have about a week left, I'm going to flag our pharmacist to give you a call and check on that emergency supply option, just in case. You should hear from them soon.
CALLER: Oh, thank you, honey, that's a relief. You have a good day now, bye bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S10-F1.judged.1: Tells her plainly that lisinopril has no refills left.
S10-F1.judged.2: Gives a rough timeline of about 1 to 2 business days.
S10-F1.judged.3: Reads back the outcome slowly at the end.
S10-F1.judged.4: Says lisinopril is refilled or ready.
S10-F1.judged.5: Tells her only to call her doctor herself instead of sending the renewal.

JSON only.

message.content: {"S10-F1.judged.1": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 13, "why": "Agent explicitly states lisinopril has zero refills left."}, "S10-F1.judged.2": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "No mention of a 1-2 business day timeline anywhere in the call."}, "S10-F1.judged.3": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 21, "why": "Agent states outcome but does not read it back slowly."}, "S10-F1.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never claims lisinopril is refilled or ready."}, "S10-F1.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 19, "why": "Agent sent the renewal request itself, not telling her to call doctor."}}
